#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

# --- 1. Hash the password on the host ---
HASH=$(python3 - <<'EOF'
import base64, hashlib, os
salt = os.urandom(16)
key = hashlib.pbkdf2_hmac('sha512', os.environ['MASS_PASSWORD'].encode(), salt, 100000, 64)
print('@ByteArray(' + base64.b64encode(salt).decode() + ':' + base64.b64encode(key).decode() + ')')
EOF
)

# --- 2. Stop qBittorrent, set username + hash under [Preferences], start it ---
pct exec 105 -- systemctl stop qbittorrent-nox.service

pct exec 105 -- python3 - <<PYEOF
import re, sys

conf_path = '/var/lib/qbittorrent-nox/.config/qBittorrent/qBittorrent-data.conf'
with open(conf_path, 'r') as f:
    content = f.read()

# Ensure [Preferences] section exists
if '[Preferences]' not in content:
    content += '\n[Preferences]\n'

# Remove any existing WebUI username/password keys
content = re.sub(r'^WebUI\\\\Username=.*$', '', content, flags=re.MULTILINE)
content = re.sub(r'^WebUI\\\\Password_PBKDF2=$MASS_PASSWORD', '', content, flags=re.MULTILINE)

# Insert the new keys under [Preferences]
prefs_marker = '[Preferences]'
idx = content.index(prefs_marker) + len(prefs_marker)
insertion = '\nWebUI\\\\Username=admin\nWebUI\\\\Password_PBKDF2='$HASH'\n'
content = content[:idx] + insertion + content[idx:]

with open(conf_path, 'w') as f:
    f.write(content)
PYEOF

pct exec 105 -- systemctl start qbittorrent-nox.service

# --- 3. Prove the login from the host ---
sleep 3
LOGIN_RESULT=$(curl -s -d "username=admin&password=$MASS_PASSWORD" http://192.168.1.24:8080/api/v2/auth/login)
echo "Login result: $LOGIN_RESULT"
if [ "$LOGIN_RESULT" != "Ok." ]; then
    echo "ERROR: qBittorrent login did not return 'Ok.'. Hash format may be wrong for this build."
    exit 1
fi

# --- 4. Tell Radarr and Sonarr the same credentials ---
# Radarr (container 103)
pct exec 103 -- systemctl stop radarr.service

pct exec 103 -- python3 - <<PYEOF
import re, sys

conf_path = '/var/lib/radarr/config.xml'
with open(conf_path, 'r') as f:
    content = f.read()

# Remove existing DownloadClientConfig if present
content = re.sub(r'<DownloadClientConfig>.*?</DownloadClientConfig>', '', content, flags=re.DOTALL)

# Insert DownloadClientConfig before </Config>
insertion = '<DownloadClientConfig><DownloadClientWorkingFolders>_UNPACK_|_UNPACK</DownloadClientWorkingFolders><CheckForFinishedDownloadInterval>1</CheckForFinishedDownloadInterval><EnableCompletedDownloadHandling>True</EnableCompletedDownloadHandling><AutoRedownloadFailed>True</AutoRedownloadFailed></DownloadClientConfig>'
content = content.replace('</Config>', insertion + '</Config>')

with open(conf_path, 'w') as f:
    f.write(content)
PYEOF

pct exec 103 -- systemctl start radarr.service
sleep 3

# Update the qBittorrent download client in Radarr with credentials
pct exec 103 -- sh -c 'curl -s --fail-with-body -X PUT -H "X-Api-Key: $(cat /var/lib/radarr/config.xml 2>/dev/null | sed -n "s:.*<ApiKey>\\(.*\\)</ApiKey>.*:\\1:p" | head -n 1)" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d "{\"name\":\"qBittorrent\",\"implementation\":\"QBittorrent\",\"enable\":true,\"host\":\"192.168.1.24\",\"port\":8080,\"movieCategory\":\"radarr\",\"username\":\"admin\",\"password\":\"'$MASS_PASSWORD'\",\"id\":1}" http://127.0.0.1:7878/api/v3/downloadclient/1'

# Sonarr (container 104)
pct exec 104 -- systemctl stop sonarr.service

pct exec 104 -- python3 - <<PYEOF
import re, sys

conf_path = '/var/lib/sonarr/config.xml'
with open(conf_path, 'r') as f:
    content = f.read()

# Remove existing DownloadClientConfig if present
content = re.sub(r'<DownloadClientConfig>.*?</DownloadClientConfig>', '', content, flags=re.DOTALL)

# Insert DownloadClientConfig before </Config>
insertion = '<DownloadClientConfig><DownloadClientWorkingFolders>_UNPACK_|_UNPACK</DownloadClientWorkingFolders><CheckForFinishedDownloadInterval>1</CheckForFinishedDownloadInterval><EnableCompletedDownloadHandling>True</EnableCompletedDownloadHandling><AutoRedownloadFailed>True</AutoRedownloadFailed></DownloadClientConfig>'
content = content.replace('</Config>', insertion + '</Config>')

with open(conf_path, 'w') as f:
    f.write(content)
PYEOF

pct exec 104 -- systemctl start sonarr.service
sleep 3

# Update the qBittorrent download client in Sonarr with credentials
pct exec 104 -- sh -c 'curl -s --fail-with-body -X PUT -H "X-Api-Key: $(cat /var/lib/sonarr/config.xml 2>/dev/null | sed -n "s:.*<ApiKey>\\(.*\\)</ApiKey>.*:\\1:p" | head -n 1)" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d "{\"name\":\"qBittorrent\",\"implementation\":\"QBittorrent\",\"enable\":true,\"host\":\"192.168.1.24\",\"port\":8080,\"tvCategory\":\"tv-sonarr\",\"username\":\"admin\",\"password\":\"'$MASS_PASSWORD'\",\"id\":1}" http://127.0.0.1:8989/api/v3/downloadclient/1'

# --- 5. Run each app's downloadclient/test ---
echo "--- Radarr download client test ---"
pct exec 103 -- sh -c 'curl -s --fail-with-body -X POST -H "X-Api-Key: $(cat /var/lib/radarr/config.xml 2>/dev/null | sed -n "s:.*<ApiKey>\\(.*\\)</ApiKey>.*:\\1:p" | head -n 1)" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d "{\"name\":\"qBittorrent\",\"implementation\":\"QBittorrent\",\"enable\":true,\"host\":\"192.168.1.24\",\"port\":8080,\"movieCategory\":\"radarr\",\"username\":\"admin\",\"password\":\"'$MASS_PASSWORD'\",\"id\":1}" http://127.0.0.1:7878/api/v3/downloadclient/test'

echo "--- Sonarr download client test ---"
pct exec 104 -- sh -c 'curl -s --fail-with-body -X POST -H "X-Api-Key: $(cat /var/lib/sonarr/config.xml 2>/dev/null | sed -n "s:.*<ApiKey>\\(.*\\)</ApiKey>.*:\\1:p" | head -n 1)" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d "{\"name\":\"qBittorrent\",\"implementation\":\"QBittorrent\",\"enable\":true,\"host\":\"192.168.1.24\",\"port\":8080,\"tvCategory\":\"tv-sonarr\",\"username\":\"admin\",\"password\":\"'$MASS_PASSWORD'\",\"id\":1}" http://127.0.0.1:8989/api/v3/downloadclient/test'

echo "--- Done ---"
